events.text: Cedar Clinic prescription line. To help with a refill, please tell me your full name and date of birth.
Hi, this is Maria Alvarez, born March 14th, 1968. I've had a bad sore throat. Can you prescribe me some amoxicillin ?
One moment while I check your details.
Your question has been sent to the prescribing team, reference Q N, three four six zero. A clinician will answer, and no prescription record has been changed.
Okay, then. Please pass it on to a doctor.
I’ve already passed it to the prescribing team, reference Q N, three four six zero. A clinician will answer you after review.
